generated.what_happened: Cristiano Ronaldo announced that he has left Portugal's national team training camp in Copenhagen ahead of their UEFA Nations League match against Denmark. The decision followed a conversation with Portuguese Football Federation president Pedro Proença and a press conference where head coach Jorge Jesus confirmed the 41-year-old would not start on Thursday, having also remained an unused substitute during Sunday's win over Norway. While Jesus insisted there was no rift and explained his lineup choices were based on tactical decisions and player rotation, Ronaldo stated on social media that he would reveal the truth behind his exit in due course. The Portuguese Football Federation confirmed his departure, stating that the remaining 24-man squad will proceed with preparations for their upcoming matches against Denmark and Norway.
